title: Command R7B Release
summary: Cohere announced Command R7B on December 13, 2024 as the smallest and fastest model in its R family of enterprise-focused large language models, with a 128K context window.
significance: A dated release milestone in Cohere's Command R model family, establishing the release and availability boundary for Command R7B.

verification.note: Cohere's first-party release note is dated December 13, 2024 and explicitly announces the release of Command R7B, identifies a 128K context window, and states that it was available that day on the Cohere Platform and Hugging Face and through the SDK as command-r7b-12-2024. Cohere's current first-party model documentation independently corroborates the model identity, R-family positioning, 128K context window, model ID, and availability.
